article: Excelカレンダーテンプレート（日本の祝日対応）
findings: Removed the duplicated injected 2026 date from all 13 editions, preserving original publication date 2024-05-01 and recording 2026-11-23 as lastmod.
Inspected XLSX formulas: Japanese holiday dates and names are retrieved through Excel WEBSERVICE from third-party ExcelAPI. Replaced all embedded http://api.excelapi.org URLs with HTTPS.
Added locale-specific compatibility notes explaining internet/external-service dependency and Microsoft’s documented limitation that WEBSERVICE does not return results in Excel for Mac.

Checked the 200 formula cells overall: 100 holiday-list and 100 holiday-name WEBSERVICE formulas (shared formula ranges expanded), plus calendar date formulas. Confirmed all 12 translations, localized references, and workbook target. No recalculation or live API request was made.
scope: Read the full Japanese article and all twelve available translations and inspected XLSX formulas. Compared meaning, terminology, date metadata, links, endpoints, and calendar formulas. Editions are intentionally concise.
